artifacts.bundle_name: TPUSA Corporate Zoom Call Audio Bundle

sub_items.description: Erika Kirk opening the call – thanking staff and citing memorial attendance (over 275,000), broadcast reach (over 100 million), merchandise sales, and voter registrations; noting staff "20our" (20-hour) days during memorial prep; introducing the phrase "Turning Point USA 2.0."

Erika Kirk addressing grief – listing counselors, pastors, therapy dogs, paid flights for spouses, and advising employees that paid time off is available through standard channels if more time is needed.

Erika Kirk discussing "Vision 2030" – stating Charlie was working on a 2030 plan with Justin (newly appointed COO); stating she possesses Charlie's journals documenting the plans; expressing hesitation before saying she is "excited."

Text message from Charlie Kirk to Candace Owens (dated by host to 2018) – "Since the beginning of Turning Point USA, I knew in my gut that I might get wiped out at any time. I cannot explain it, but I dream about it all the time. Like all the time. Not really afraid of it, but I'm just telling you what I know to be true. I'm not sure I'm going to live to see the end of this revolution."

Atlantic article excerpt read on air describing Bill Montgomery meeting Charlie Kirk at Benedictine University (Lisle, Illinois western suburb) at a youth government day in May 2012, Montgomery's recollection that he told Kirk "I don't know you, but you need to start an organization to reach out to young people with your message," and the duo launching TPUSA a month later.

artifacts.bundle_name: New York Times Profile Article Bundle

sub_items.description: New York Times profile article on Erika Kirk containing the quoted statement that becoming a single mother "is actually the least traumatizing thing for me since she herself has been raised by her mother after their parents divorced when she was young," with reference to Trump's tone on phone calls being "soft and embracing."
Phone threat message targeting TPUSA, previously displayed in an earlier episode; now identified by host and attributed via audio match to Laurie Cardoza-Moore.

Audio recording of Laurie Cardoza-Moore ranting in her car about Tucker Carlson's speech at a TPUSA Tampa conference, Michele Bachmann's five-minute pro-Israel segment, audience booing and 10% walkout, and Charlie Kirk's failure to defend Israel or condemn Tucker.
Vintage 1-900 romance hotline advertisement audio ("Are you over 30 and single? … Romance Hotline 1-900-980-…") played on air for voice matching to Laurie Cardoza-Moore.

artifacts.bundle_name: WSJ Kanye Apology Ad Reference Bundle

sub_items.description: Reference (verbally cited only) to a full-page Wall Street Journal apology advertisement by Kanye West. Not displayed or read aloud in this episode.

artifacts.bundle_name: Vanity Fair Kanye Interview Reference Bundle

sub_items.description: Reference (verbally cited only) to a Vanity Fair interview/Q&A with Kanye West discussing bipolar medication, 2024/2025 as a tough year, and characterizing the apology as not a PR move. Not displayed or read aloud in this episode.

artifacts.bundle_name: Live Chat Comments Read on Air Bundle

sub_items.description: Comment from "Comic Nick" – "I said this last week … why wouldn't Charlie Kirk tell Erika Kirk that they were going to kill him unless he was scared that she was a part of it."
Comment from "Becca" – "When Erika talks, she is so boring. She has not had that special thing that Charlie had … She is unlikable on the surface because she acts elite. Goodbye, Turning Point USA."
Comment from "Jay Burgerer" – "Don't forget MLK started college at 15 and had a faith-based movement by the time that he was 21."
Comment from "Coffee addicted Mama Bear" – "I ordered your book the second you said you were shipping to Canada."

Comment from "Adriana New Jersey" – "Erika plays a role that she thinks men want. She did not have the same values as Charlie … The comment in the New York Times was, 'Who needs a man? Being a single mother is okay.' That is the opposite of Charlie's views."
Comment from "Joseph Brown" – Incomplete ("Candace Owens, uh, curious").
Comment from "Joel" – "Geoengineering has become really fake and gay. The sidewalks at my apartments were covered in ice. It was like styrofoam … HAARP must be drunk."
Comment from "Dagert Ar Jonah" – Birthday request for wife Cresenda Arjona / Arona.
Comment from "Seven Sheets" – "I didn't know that much about CK before this, but could tell a man of integrity. I feel like I mourned him longer than EK or TPUSA did."
Comment from "Maria Rits / Jolly Valley girl" – "Hey Jolly Valley girl tone excited to be discussing business numbers and goals is super cringe and weird."

Comment from "Jess Happy" – "And to think that all I thought about on September 10th was how empty and terrified Erika must feel and how sad I was for those babies. How ironic crisis can keep going, Candace."
Host verbal reference to an email from someone who attended the September 22 private dinner, saying the group was in joyous spirits (email not shown)

claims.label: Erika Kirk opened the TPUSA Zoom call with an upbeat tone thanking staff and citing memorial metrics
claims.claim: In a clip of the TPUSA corporate-wide Zoom call that the host plays, Erika Kirk opens by thanking staff and citing memorial metrics including 275,000 attendees and broadcast reach of "over 100 million"; the host describes the call's tone as upbeat, with laughter.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full 15-minute Zoom call audio for content and tone analysis; corroborate cited metrics with TPUSA financial/disclosure filings.

claims.label: Erika Kirk stated staff worked 20-hour days during the week of the memorial
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Erika Kirk tells the call that "a lot of this the staff that worked on the memorial, they had 20[-hour] days for a week during the time of us grieving the loss of my husband."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference staff schedules, payroll records, and contemporaneous internal communications to verify the 20-hour-day claim.

claims.label: Erika Kirk advised employees that paid time off is available if they need more time to grieve
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Erika Kirk tells employees: "if you do need additional time off, please talk to your director about using paid time off for that," while also saying that leadership provided counselors, pastors and, she heard, therapy dogs during the memorial period.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Erika's PTO framing with TPUSA's stated employee policies and the subsequent terminations of staff reportedly working on the memorial.

claims.label: Erika Kirk referenced a "Vision 2030" plan she attributes to Charlie and to COO Justin
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Erika Kirk states Charlie was working on "vision 2030" in the weeks before September 10 with Justin, who had been appointed COO for that purpose.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA board minutes, executive announcements regarding Justin's appointment, and any Vision 2030 documents; compare timeline against Charlie's known 2025 public statements.

claims.label: Erika Kirk stated she possesses Charlie's journals documenting the 2030 plans
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Erika Kirk states: "I have his journals that are aware of the plans. Like there is no confusion of what's to come."
claims.investigative_direction: Establish provenance, chain of custody, and authenticity of any journals Erika cites; determine whether the journals have been produced to the board or to TPUSA counsel.

claims.label: Erika Kirk used the phrase "Turning Point USA 2.0"
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Erika Kirk states on the call: "we are moving forward turning point USA 2.0 with Charlie in our hearts."
claims.investigative_direction: Determine whether "TPUSA 2.0" branding has been formally adopted in organizational materials, IRS filings, or governance documents.

claims.label: Erika Kirk described becoming a single mother as "the least traumatizing thing" in a NYT interview
claims.claim: The episode presents a quoted excerpt from the NYT profile in which Erika Kirk, eight days after Charlie's assassination, characterizes single motherhood as "actually the least traumatizing thing for me since she herself has been raised by her mother after their parents divorced when she was young."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify full NYT article text and date of publication; compare framing against prior public statements by Erika Kirk regarding the timing of the interview.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk texted Candace Owens in 2018 saying he knew from the start of TPUSA he might die
claims.claim: The episode presents a 2018 text message from Charlie Kirk to Candace Owens stating: "Since the beginning of Turning Point USA, I knew in my gut that I might get wiped out at any time … I dream about it all the time … I'm not sure I'm going to live to see the end of this revolution."
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate the text via metadata (date, device, recipient); compare against other contemporaneous statements made by Charlie Kirk about his own safety.

claims.label: Atlantic article reports Bill Montgomery met Charlie at Benedictine University in May 2012 and co-founded TPUSA
claims.claim: The episode presents an Atlantic article excerpt (quoting a National Journal source) reporting Bill Montgomery met Charlie Kirk at Benedictine University in the western Chicago suburb during a youth government day in May 2012 and that TPUSA launched a month later with Montgomery's encouragement.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the full Atlantic article; cross-check Bill Montgomery's Air Force service record and his post-2012 role; investigate any alternative TPUSA origin narratives.

claims.label: Host Says Christian Zionist Threat Message Echoes Laurie Cardoza-Moore's Online Rant
claims.claim: The host says that virtually everything said in the previously circulated Christian Zionist threat message was also in a rant Laurie Cardoza-Moore did live on the internet about Tucker Carlson's speech, and plays audio of her ranting in her car.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent forensic voice comparison; verify Laurie Cardoza-Moore's identity, contact details, and any prior communications with TPUSA staff or affiliates.

claims.label: Host Says Internet Sleuths Found Laurie Cardoza-Moore's Background in Acting and Romance Hotlines
claims.claim: The host says, citing findings by internet sleuths of the "decentralized intelligence agency," that Laurie Cardoza-Moore's background is in acting and romance hotlines, and plays a 1-900 romance hotline advertisement.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish provenance and dating of the romance hotline recording; obtain Laurie Cardoza-Moore's professional résumé or acting credits for corroboration.

claims.label: Erika Kirk gave an in-person NYT interview on September 18, 2025
claims.claim: The episode presents that Erika Kirk gave an in-person interview to the New York Times at her and Charlie's condo on September 18, 2025 – eight days after Charlie's public assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify NYT byline, interview location, and publication date; compare with NYT editorial logs and any contemporaneous NYT reporter commentary.

claims.label: Host identifies show community as Decentralized Intelligence Agency
claims.claim: The host refers to internet sleuths as the DCIA, the decentralized intelligence agency, which she says is moving quicker.
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve as brand / network framing claim; cross-link M-12 meme occurrence when present.
claims.transcript_snippet: ...ernet sloohs aren't playing around. the DCIA, the decentralized intelligence agency, is moving quicker. And they found that, yeah, that's what Lor's background is in acting and for ro...

claims.label: Host Says Erika Led the Call About 12 Days After the Assassination
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk, installed as the new CEO and chairman, headed up a conference call about 12 days after Charlie Kirk was assassinated, just after the memorial event.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the call date and invitee list through TPUSA internal calendar invitations or the leaked recording's metadata.
claims.transcript_snippet: She headed up this conference call about 12 days after Charlie was assassinated, just after the memorial event.

claims.label: Host Commits to a Multi-Episode Series on Erika Kirk's Background
claims.claim: The host says she is committing to a couple of episodes, possibly a three-part series, to separate fact from fiction about the background of Erika Kirk, whom she describes as the new chairman and CEO of a charity.
claims.investigative_direction: Track the subsequent episodes in the series and compare each stated background fact against primary records.
claims.transcript_snippet: We are doing a couple of episodes to separate fact from fiction when it comes to the background of Erika Kirk because the public deserves to know

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Raised Over a Quarter Billion Dollars After the Assassination
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA is a charitable organization that raised over a quarter of a billion dollars following the assassination of its founder.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the figure against TPUSA and Turning Point Action donation disclosures, Form 990 filings and any public statements by the organization.
claims.transcript_snippet: a charitable organization which happened to have raised over a quarter of a billion dollars following the assassination of its founder

claims.label: Host Says Employees Who Worked 20-Hour Days Were Fired Without a Clear Reason
claims.claim: The host says a group of employees who factually worked 20-hour days were then fired without being given a clear reason, which she says Erika confirms on the call about the long days, and that the firings came in the new year with a message of moving in a different direction.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain termination notices or severance paperwork for staff who worked on the memorial and check the stated reasons and dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: especially the recent bout of paranoia where we had a bunch of employees who factually worked 20our days.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Is Accountable to the Public Despite Cease and Desist Letters
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA, as a 501(c)(3) charity, is accountable to the public, who are allowed to ask questions even if it wants to send out a bunch of cease and desist letters.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain copies of any cease and desist letters from TPUSA or its counsel and identify the recipients.
claims.transcript_snippet: They are allowed to ask questions even if you want to send out a bunch of cease and desist letters.

claims.label: Host Says the Leaked Zoom Call Took Place on Monday, September 22
claims.claim: The host says her team obtained an audio recording of a corporate-wide Zoom call that took place on Monday, September 22, which she describes as 11 days (less than two weeks) after Charlie Kirk was publicly assassinated.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the call date from recording metadata or the Zoom invitation and identify who recorded and leaked it.
claims.transcript_snippet: So for clarity, this call took took place on Monday, uh, September 22nd.

claims.label: Host Says the Call Came About 48 Hours After a Private Catholic Funeral Mass
claims.claim: The host says the call came about 48 hours after Charlie Kirk's private Catholic funeral mass, which the public was not privy to.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish the date, venue and attendee list of the funeral mass through the church or TPUSA statements.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's also less than 48 hours about 48 hours after his uh private Catholic funeral mass which the public was not privy to.

claims.label: Host Says Top-Paying Donors Were Privy to the Funeral Mass
claims.claim: The host says top-paying donors were privy to the private funeral mass even though the public was not, and calls that odd.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify which donors attended the funeral mass and how invitations were issued.
claims.transcript_snippet: Um but top paying donors were that's also odd.

claims.label: Host Says She Went Away to Wyoming After the Assassination
claims.claim: The host says she had to go away to Wyoming just to breathe after the assassination, and that she was away for two weeks, so she did not catch until later that Erika's New York Times interview was in person.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the host's own timeline of travel and posting during September 2025 against public posts.
claims.transcript_snippet: You remember I had to go away to Wyoming just to breathe.

claims.label: NYT Article Quotes Erika Saying the President's Tone Was Soft and Embracing
claims.claim: The host reads from the New York Times profile of Erika Kirk, which quotes her as saying President Trump's tone on phone calls was soft and embracing and that she could tell he wanted to hug her.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original New York Times article and confirm the wording and the date of the interview.
claims.transcript_snippet: The president's tone she said was soft and embracing. I could tell he wanted to hug me.

claims.label: NYT Article Describes Erika Left to Care for a Three-Year-Old Daughter and a One-Year-Old Son
claims.claim: The host reads that the New York Times describes Erika Kirk as now left to care for a three-year-old daughter and a one-year-old son.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the children's ages in the published article and against other reporting.
claims.transcript_snippet: now left to care for a three-year-old daughter and a one-year-old son.

claims.label: Host Places the Funeral Mass on September 20 at 11 a.m.
claims.claim: The host says the funeral mass was held on the 20th at a church at 11:00 a.m., as part of the timeline she is building around the call.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the funeral mass date, time and venue through the church or contemporaneous reporting.
claims.transcript_snippet: On the 20th, we have the funeral mass which is held at a church at 11:00 a. m.

claims.label: Host Places the Public Memorial at State Farm Stadium on September 21
claims.claim: The host says the public memorial event was held on the 21st at State Farm Stadium.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against stadium and event records and contemporaneous coverage (publicly documented).
claims.transcript_snippet: On the 21st is the public memorial event that is held at State Farm Stadium.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Attended a Private Dinner with the McCoys on September 22
claims.claim: The host says that on the 22nd there was a private dinner, at a restaurant she declines to name, attended by the McCoys (Elizabeth, Mikey) and Erika, who were, per an email from someone who was there, in joyous spirits.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the restaurant and attendees via receipts, reservations or the host's email source.
claims.transcript_snippet: There's a private dinner. Not going to mention what restaurant it's at, but the McCoys are there. Elizabeth, Mikey, Erika, uh, and they're in joyous spirits

claims.label: Host Says the Full Call Is 15 Minutes and She Is Not Playing All of It
claims.claim: The host says the entire call is 15 minutes long, that she is not playing all of it, and that she will work out how to post it on her X feed, adding that she is not cutting it for drama.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full 15-minute recording and compare the aired excerpts against it for context.
claims.transcript_snippet: Now, the entirety of this call, which we're not going to play, is 15 minutes long.

claims.label: Erika Says Thousands Registered to Vote and Merch Sales Passed 200,000
claims.claim: On the call, Erika Kirk says thousands were registered to vote and that merch sales were at over 200,000, adding that people should not quote her because the figure keeps bumping up.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the stated voter registration and merch figures with TPUSA sales data and later disclosures.
claims.transcript_snippet: We had thousands that were registered to vote. I think we're at like over 200,000 for merch sales. Don't quote me on that

claims.label: Erika Says Several Staff Did Not Even Sleep During Memorial Preparation
claims.claim: On the call, Erika Kirk says she knows several staff members who did not even sleep while working on the memorial.
claims.investigative_direction: Interview staff who worked on the memorial about hours and sleep, and compare with payroll or badge records.
claims.transcript_snippet: I know several staff that didn't even sleep.

claims.label: Erika Tells Staff to Put Grievances to Rest and Says Her Husband Is Dead
claims.claim: On the call, Erika Kirk urges staff to put to rest any beef with each other, saying that her husband is dead and that life is short.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish whether internal TPUSA conflicts existed at the time and who the message was aimed at.
claims.transcript_snippet: I don't care if any of you have beef with each other from the past

claims.label: Erika Says She Insisted on Paying Flights for Staff Spouses
claims.claim: On the call, Erika Kirk says she was adamant that TPUSA pay for staff members' spouses to fly in to be there, saying no one is supposed to grieve alone.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain travel and expense records showing who flew in for the memorial and who paid.
claims.transcript_snippet: I was I was really adamant about making sure that we paid for your flights for your spouses to be there.

claims.label: Erika Says Charlie Would Want Staff Back at Work and TPUSA Will Steam Ahead
claims.claim: On the call, Erika Kirk says that Turning Point USA and Turning Point Action will steam ahead and that Charlie would want them to get back to work, which she says is what they did with the memorial.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the call's stated work pace with TPUSA event and staffing records after September 10.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie would want us to get back to work and that's what we're doing and that's what we did with the memorial

claims.label: Erika Says TPUSA Has 100,000 Chapter Requests and 300,000 New Donors Since the Assassination
claims.claim: On the call, Erika Kirk says that since Charlie's assassination TPUSA has 100,000 chapter requests and 300,000 new donors.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the claimed chapter requests and new donors with TPUSA's own later statements, filings and donor-platform data.
claims.transcript_snippet: since his assassination, uh, we have 100,000 chapter 100,000 chapter requests. Uh, we have 300,000 new donors.

claims.label: Erika Says 50,000 Hat Orders and Over 20,000 AmFest Registrations
claims.claim: On the call, Erika Kirk says she thinks there are 50,000 plus hat orders to fulfill and says there are over 20,000 AmFest registrations.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with TPUSA merchandise fulfillment records and AmFest registration counts reported later.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think we have 50,000 plus hat orders to fulfill.

claims.label: Host Says Employees Told Her the Call Left Them Feeling Strange About Taking Time Off
claims.claim: The host says employees told her that after exhausting work on the memorial they heard 'use your paid time off if you need to grieve' while the wife of the founder said she was full steam ahead, which left them wondering whether they were weird for wanting to grieve.
claims.investigative_direction: Interview employees who were on the call, preferably on the record, about how the paid time off message was received.
claims.transcript_snippet: So basically what the employees said to me was that they got onto this call and you know everyone's exhausted

claims.label: Erika Says Charlie and Justin Talked Plans on Night Walk Phone Calls
claims.claim: On the call, Erika Kirk says Justin had been appointed COO because Charlie worked closely with him on vision 2030, and she recalls phone calls at 10:00 at night during her and Charlie's night walks in which the two talked about the plans.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Justin Streiff and TPUSA board members to confirm the 2030 planning conversations and the timing of his COO appointment.
claims.transcript_snippet: I remember phone calls when Charlie and I would take our night walks and it would be 10:00 at night and him and Justin would just be talking about the plans.

claims.label: Erika Says the Board and She Are Working With Justin to Implement the 2030 Plans
claims.claim: On the call, Erika Kirk says the board and she are working with Justin and the executive leadership teams to make sure the plans come into effect for 2030 and beyond.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain board minutes and executive team announcements on the 2030 plan.
